macroNarrative: Nifty at 22,520 continues to grind near its 52-week low even as Bank Nifty outperforms (+0.99%) and Sensex posts a marginal gain, with the index now on watch for a possible ninth straight weekly loss despite today's stabilisation; Brent's sharp +4.1% jump to $104.72 alongside INR sliding to a fresh 96.73/USD print reintroduces the twin headwinds of imported inflation and currency pressure that had briefly eased. IT services bucked the gloom — TCS's Q2 beat (stock +5.6%) and Hexaware's Anthropic tie-up (+12%) snapped an eight-week sectoral losing streak, though analysts flagged margin softness underneath the growth. Nifty 50 YTD stands at approx -8% and Nifty Smallcap 100 at approx -14%, a reminder that disciplined stock selection — not passive beta — has been the only way to avoid real capital erosion this year.

conviction.name: HDFC Bank
conviction.thesis: Largest private bank with India's best liability franchise; CD ratio normalisation post-merger continues, and today's Bank Nifty leadership (+0.99%, HDFC Bank among the day's gainers per headlines) reflects the market rewarding asset-quality clarity. Cash generation is strong via deposit-funded compounding; no red flags on auditor or related-party fronts.

Credit cycle recovery broadening
Continued CASA share gains

conviction.accounting_red_flags: None identified; clean audit history, no pledging.
